svg.metadata: Vladivostok, Noon. Approved conceptual map, Day08 Utopia. NG Cartography, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Source mapping © OpenStreetMap contributors, snapshot 25 October 2026, ODbL 1.0. produced using Copernicus WorldDEM-30 © DLR e.V. 2010-2014 and © Airbus Defence and Space GmbH 2014-2018 provided under COPERNICUS by the European Union and ESA; all rights reserved. Terrain and dense mapped fabric are rasterised; coast, proposed uses, connections and typography are vector paths. Text is outlined; no font software is embedded. Shared access and programmes are an imagined future, not operating facilities or a development plan.
